summary: Account is brand new (<100 followers). Weakest: Reel hooks lose 76% viewers in first 3 seconds; Bluesky posts get zero engagement. Instagram bio violates rules (niche, region, timeframe, free offer).
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: open with a blunt, relatable pain point in plain Hinglish/English (e.g., "You're missing calls while you work") — avoid question hooks (used 2026-10-12) and contrast hooks (used 2026-10-17).
- Topics to avoid: "24-hour delivery", "Rs 1,499 price", "free site check" — these are bio claims, not post topics, and repeat across recent posts.
- Remember: every post must read like a developer showing real work, never an ad. No demos, no guaranteed results, no niche targeting.

instructions.research: Find 3 recent Google Maps searches for "newly opened" + service type (cafe, gym, clinic) in different Indian cities; note common missing contact details.
instructions.analysis: Compare the lead sheet columns (name, phone, website, review count, place_id) against what a freelancer actually needs to pitch — identify one gap to mention in the post.
instructions.writer: Write a lead-gen post for freelancers/agencies: start with "Freelancers, agencies, anyone selling a service —" then describe the sheet in general terms (Google Places data, contact details, review counts, website check, newly opened). End with "DM me" and pay-after-approval line.
instructions.image: Create a simple screenshot-style graphic: a blurred spreadsheet header showing columns (Business, Phone, Website, Reviews, Place ID) with "Sample data" watermark. No logos, no brand colors.
instructions.video: Skip video today — Reel hook failure rate is 76%; focus on static image post to test copy first.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "Websites, chatbots, animated ads & lead sheets for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice." (removes niche, region, timeframe, free offer).
Comment on 5 posts by Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition — add value, don't pitch.
Reply to any story mentions or tags from collaborators (editorxyz_official, shiven_xyz) with a genuine thank-you, no self-promo.
